ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, point E is on BC, and $BE=3EC$. D is the midpoint of AC, AE and BD intersect at point F, what is the value of $AF: EF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Construct $EH\parallel AC$ through point E and intersect BD at point H, as shown in the figure:\\
Since $EH\parallel AC$,\\
thus $\triangle BEH\sim \triangle BCD$\\
therefore $\frac{EH}{CD}=\frac{BE}{BC}$,\\
since $BE=3EC$,\\
therefore $\frac{EH}{CD}=\frac{3CE}{4CE}=\frac{3}{4}$,\\
since $D$ is the midpoint of $AC$,\\
therefore $AD=CD$,\\
therefore $\frac{EH}{CD}=\frac{EH}{AD}=\frac{3}{4}$,\\
since $EH\parallel AC$,\\
therefore $\frac{AF}{EF}=\frac{AD}{EH}=\frac{4}{3}$,\\
therefore $AF\colon EF=\boxed{4\colon 3}$.
